NEWS
Change By Exchange
For over 100 years, the DAAD has been promoting interna‐
tional academic exchange, contributing substantially to
change in society, politics, the economy, science, technol‐
ogy, the arts and culture. Historical insights and inspiring
portraits of DAAD alumni illustrate how exchange has
shaped the world yesterday, today and tomorrow.
LEARN MORE
DAAD Newsletters – Stay up to date
Receive the latest news about current events and projects and
explore the grounds of academic exchange in various
DAAD newsletters. Find your newsletter of interest here.
Newsletter - DAAD
